english.title: Cause or permit private hire vehicle to enter Manchester Airport when not pre-booked or in designated car park
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused or permitted a private hire vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to enter Manchester Airport for the purpose of loading passengers when the vehicle had not been pre-booked or was not to be parked in a designated car park or area in anticipation of such a booking
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 6.2 of the Manchester Airport Byelaws 2024.
